Child of bank_logistic_default with stronger regularization to control variance on the small precontact feature set; same protocol and AP evaluation.
Child of bank_forest_default using class_weight balanced to address class imbalance while keeping fixed random_state and bounded n_jobs for CPU/memory limits.
